script_text: Taurus, your grounded Earth nature is being shaken by a cosmic tremor you cannot ignore. Venus, your ruling planet, is forming a sharp square to Saturn in your 10th House of public reputation and career authority. This tension creates a direct collision between your professional ambitions and your private need for security. In matters of the heart, a sudden opposition from Mars in your 7th House suggests a confrontation with a partner or a magnetic, high-intensity stranger who challenges your stability. Regarding your finances, Jupiter’s sextile to your 2nd House of personal assets signals a sudden, unexpected windfall or a lucrative new contract. Avoid making impulsive luxury purchases today to prevent a temporary drain on your resources. Subscribe so you don't miss what's coming this week.
